title: ERA: Embed, Route, Adapt for Cold-Start Cross-Model Latent Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.26919v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Production retrieval systems are tied to the embedding model that indexed their corpus. Moving queries to a different encoder normally requires re-embedding the whole corpus, and at cold start there are no query logs while every document embedded by the new encoder incurs an API or compute cost. We present ERA (Embed, Route, Adapt), a system for cold-start cross-model latent retrieval. ERA spends a small anchor budget on maximally informative documents, selected from the existing target index via Cosine Farthest Point Sampling, trains a lightweight adapter with a Manifold Alignment Loss that couples directional alignment with orthogonal regularization to prevent representation collapse, and pairs the adapter with a deterministic router that escalates the rare, hard queries that define perceived retrieval quality. Across five BEIR datasets, ERA matches or outperforms point-wise L2 and embedding-conversion baselines, with relative gains

translated_title: ERA：面向冷启动跨模型潜在检索的嵌入、路由与自适应方法
translated_abstract: 生产级检索系统与其语料库索引所使用的嵌入模型紧密绑定。将查询迁移到不同的编码器通常需要对整个语料库重新进行嵌入，而在冷启动阶段既没有查询日志可供利用，新编码器对每个文档进行嵌入也会产生API调用或计算成本。我们提出了ERA（Embed, Route, Adapt），一个面向冷启动跨模型潜在检索的系统。ERA将少量锚点预算分配给最具信息量的文档（通过余弦最远点采样从现有目标索引中选取），使用流形对齐损失训练一个轻量级适配器——该损失将方向对齐与正交正则化相结合以防止表示坍缩——并将该适配器与一个确定性路由器配对，后者会升级处理那些决定用户感知检索质量的少量困难查询。在五个BEIR数据集上，ERA达到或超越了逐点L2和嵌入转换基线，取得了相对增益……
tldr: ERA提出了一种冷启动跨模型潜在检索系统，通过余弦最远点采样选取少量锚点文档、利用结合正交正则化的流形对齐损失训练轻量级适配器，并借助确定性路由器升级处理困难查询，从而无需对整个语料库重新嵌入即可将检索系统迁移到新的嵌入模型。
en_tdlr: ERA is a cold-start cross-model latent retrieval system that selects informative anchor documents via cosine farthest point sampling, trains a lightweight adapter with manifold alignment loss coupled with orthogonal regularization, and uses a deterministic router to escalate hard queries, enabling migration to a new embedding model without re-embedding the entire corpus.
